title: Hot-Water Recirculation Waste Window
dataSources: Whole-home water flow (`watermeter:flow`), water pressure (`waterpressure:reading`), irrigation control (`irrigation:zone`), water-heater events (`waterheater:event`), greywater tanks (`greywater:tank`), and utility sensors for pumps and softeners (`sumppump:event`, `wellpump:event`, `watersoftener:status`).
app: Water and plumbing telemetry from smart water meters, pressure sensors, irrigation controllers, sump and well pumps, greywater tanks, and water-heater sensors streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and vendor APIs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=waterheater:event loop_state="on"
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| stats sum(duration_min) as recirc_minutes by hour
| sort hour
description: Shows which hours of the day the hot-water recirculation loop runs the longest so wasted heat is easy to see.
value: Recirculation loops improve comfort but can quietly burn energy, making runtime by hour a useful optimization view.
implementation: Ingest loop on/off state from the water-heater controller or smart relay and aggregate by hour of day.
visualization: Column chart of recirculation minutes by hour.
grandmaExplanation: It logs when the hot-water loop is running the most, so you can trim waste without losing convenience.
